'''''Planet of Twilight''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[April]] [[1997]]. It is the final volume of an informal trilogy involving ex–[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Callista Ming]]. The previous books in the cycle are [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] ([[1995]]), also by Hambly and ''[[Darksaber (novel)|Darksaber]]'' (1995) by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].

An [[Planet of Twilight (abridged audiobook)|audio version]] narrated by [[Anthony Heald]] was released in 2007.
